cells.what_is_broken: Scaffold.of(context).showBottomSheet crashes with a failed assertion: 'bottomSheetKey.currentState != null': is not true (scaffold.dart line 2366, in ScaffoldState._buildBottomSheet._removeCurrentBottomSheet). Reproduces with high probability when tapping the back arrow at the same time as the 'show bottom sheet' button repeatedly (rapid show/pop interleaving); the failure surfaces via LocalHistoryEntry._notifyRemoved -> LocalHistoryRoute.didPop -> NavigatorState.pop/maybePop. Labels include 'c: crash' and 'p: material_ui'.
cells.title: `Scaffold.of(context).showBottomSheet` crashes
